critical_issues.msg: Hardcoded fallback DATABASE_URL contains plaintext credentials (postgres:postgres), violating Rule 51 (secrets never hardcoded); if the env var is unset in production the migration silently connects to an unintended database.
critical_issues.suggestion: Remove the fallback default; require DATABASE_URL to be set explicitly, or raise a clear error if it is absent rather than silently falling back.

critical_issues.suggestion: Add ForeignKey("customers.id", ondelete="SET NULL") to the mapped_column call for customer_id.

critical_issues.msg: Duplicate-contract check does not filter by tenant_id — tenant A's quote could find tenant B's contract via direct contract_id or quote_id enumeration (Rule 6)
critical_issues.suggestion: Add tenant_id to the duplicate check: select(ContractModel).where(and_(ContractModel.quote_id == quote_id, ContractModel.tenant_id == tenant_id))

critical_issues.msg: update_expiry() has no tenant_id parameter and applies no tenant filter — it would expire contracts across all tenants (Rule 6)

suggestions.suggestion: Add index=True to the opportunity_id mapped_column in quote.py and update the migration to include op.create_index(op.f('ix_quotes_opportunity_id'), 'quotes', ['opportunity_id']).

suggestions.msg: No response schema (e.g. ContractResponse) is defined, requiring routers to manually construct response dicts.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a ContractResponse schema referencing the existing ORM to_dict output shape for consistency.

suggestions.suggestion: Ensure the service layer can set default status='draft' and amount on quote creation; if amount requires computation from items, consider adding an explicit field or documenting the behavior.

suggestions.msg: No response schema (e.g. QuoteResponse, QuoteItemResponse) is defined.
suggestions.suggestion: Add QuoteResponse and QuoteItemResponse schemas mirroring the ORM to_dict output shape for consistent router serialization.

suggestions.msg: apply_discount() calls _calc_amount() which flushes, but then calls session.refresh(quote) without an explicit flush immediately before it — the refresh will succeed but the call chain is non-obvious (Rule 123)
suggestions.suggestion: Add an explicit await self.session.flush() before the refresh to make the lifecycle explicit, even though _calc_amount already flushes — this prevents future bugs if _calc_amount is refactored
